observations.body: The martyr addresses Antiochus as one who received prosperity and a kingdom from God yet kills and tortures God’s servants.
observations.label: A kingdom received and abused

observations.body: The passage places Human kingdom beside a kingdom received and abused.

payload.posture: Read 4 Maccabees 12:5–19 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the martyr addresses Antiochus as one who received prosperity and a kingdom from God yet kills and tortures God’s servants. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
